summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories that host and distribute weights (led by Hugging Face, which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026) and developer-facing inference platforms that serve those open models via APIs. As of Spring 2026, downloads are heavily concentrated—the top 200 models account for roughly half of all downloads—with China surpassing the U.S. in monthly model downloads. These open hubs and serverless inference providers are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open-weight distribution and fast, pay-per-token access.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central repository and community hub for open models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with hosted Inference Endpoints and serverless inference for deploying and running models.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited inference; PRO subscription ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated GPU compute billed by usage/hour; Enterprise Hub plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Model/dataset cards, versioning, and Git-based repos
Spaces for hosting interactive demos
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Download stats and download-counting infrastructure
AutoTrain and fine-tuning tooling
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and community tooling plus flexible hosting and inference.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool and runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi) with many quantized variants
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs locally with no per-token cost (optional cloud offering for larger models)
features: One-command local model download and run
Quantized GGUF models optimized for consumer hardware
OpenAI-compatible local REST API
Modelfile system for customizing models and prompts
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Easy integration with local apps and agents
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally on their own hardware without cloud dependencies.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open and community models via API, including LLMs, image/video generation, and audio models packaged as reproducible containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (Cog-packaged)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); some models priced per run or per output
features: Run any model via a simple API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image, video, and audio generation models
Automatic scaling and cold-start management
Public model sharing and versioning
Fine-tuning support for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers and product teams who want to integrate diverse open models (especially generative media) via API without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A serverless and dedicated inference platform for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, plus fine-tuning and training infrastructure at scale.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; dedicated GPU endpoints and training/fine-tuning billed by usage/hour
features: Fast, OpenAI-compatible inference API
Broad catalog of open LLMs and image models
Fine-tuning and custom model training
Dedicated endpoints and reserved GPU clusters
Optimized inference stack for high throughput and low latency
Batch inference and embeddings support
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open models who want performant, scalable inference plus fine-tuning in one place.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform optimized for low-latency, high-throughput serving of open LLMs, vision, and audio models for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed by usage; volume/enterprise plans
features: FireAttention-optimized high-speed inference engine
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling, structured output (JSON mode), and multimodal support
Fine-tuning and LoRA adapter hosting
Dedicated and on-demand deployments
Compound AI / agentic workflow tooling
platforms.best_for: Production teams and startups needing the fastest low-latency inference for open models at scale with strong tooling.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in Asia/China markets) serving a wide range of open LLMs, image, audio, and video models through a unified API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, and FLUX)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage-based pricing with free credits for new users; competitive rates for Chinese open models
features: Unified OpenAI-compatible API for text, image, audio, and video models
Strong catalog of Chinese open-weight models
Fast inference with optimized serving
Fine-tuning support
Embeddings and reranking endpoints
Cost-efficient pricing for high-volume use
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asian markets) who want affordable, fast access to leading Chinese and international open models via one API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware, serving popular open LLMs at exceptionally high token throughput.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of supported open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, Gemma, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free tier for developers; enterprise/dedicated capacity available
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU hardware
OpenAI-compatible API
Very high tokens-per-second throughput
Low and predictable latency
Function calling and JSON mode support
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications (chat, agents, voice) on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary models and inference providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing plus a small platform fee on credits; no subscription required
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Usage analytics and spend controls
Model comparison and transparent per-model pricing
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of models with one key and easy switching.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: A serverless cloud compute platform for running, deploying, and scaling custom AI/ML workloads and model inference with code-first infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Not a model catalog; runs any custom or open model you deploy
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute (per-second GPU/CPU), with free monthly credits
features: Code-first serverless GPU deployment in Python
Fast autoscaling and cold starts
Supports any open model or custom container
Batch jobs, cron, and web endpoints
Fine-tuning and training workloads
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who want full control to deploy and scale custom open-model inference and training without managing servers.
